name: How long does it take to paint the interior of an entire house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint the interior of an entire house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home interior painting project varies depending on the size of your home, the condition of the surfaces, and the complexity of the job. Generally, a typical 2,000 square foot home might take 3-7 days to complete. Larger homes or those requiring extensive repairs could take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time it takes to paint a whole home interior depends on size and condition, typically ranging from 3 to 7 days for a standard home.
